claims.text: The hotel is housed within Palazzo Sasso, a former noble residence dating back to the 12th century.

findings.quote: Housed within Palazzo Sasso, a former noble residence dating back to the 12th century

claims.text: In 2013 the hotel was renamed Palazzo Avino, after its founding family.

findings.quote: In 2013, it was renamed Palazzo Avino, finally bearing the name of its founding family.

claims.text: The hotel lobby was once a chapel built in 1756 and dedicated to Maria Maddalena Penitente.

findings.quote: In 1756, his son Andrea built a chapel dedicated to Maria Maddalena Penitente, which is now the hotel’s lobby.

claims.text: General Eisenhower planned the attack on Monte Cassino while staying at the hotel.

findings.quote: General Eisenhower planning the attack on Monte Cassino while staying at the hotel

claims.text: Sisters Mariella and Attilia Avino took over the hotel from their father, Giuseppe Avino.

findings.quote: sisters Mariella and Attilia Avino took over the hotel from their father, Giuseppe Avino

claims.text: The hotel is set 350 meters above sea level, with mountains on one side and the Gulf on the other.

findings.quote: Set 350 meters above sea level, the hotel enjoys an unparalleled position offering breathtaking views: lush green mountains on one side and the shimmering Gulf on the other

claims.text: Rossellinis is closed from November to March; during the season it serves dinner.

findings.quote: Rossellinis is closed from November to March, but during the season, it is open exclusively for dinner.

claims.text: The Sommelier's Table is a candlelit dinner for two in a cave with a specially designed Wine Library.

findings.quote: A candlelit dinner for two in this unique cave is a magical experience, where you can admire the specially designed “Wine Library.”

claims.text: The Lobster & Martini Bar serves local lobster paired with Champagne or Prosecco.

findings.quote: inviting guests to indulge in the freshest local lobster paired with refreshing Champagne or Prosecco

claims.text: Terrazza Maraviglia is a casual spot serving small bites and fresh pasta on a terrace high above the property, with coastline views.

findings.quote: offers a delightful selection of small bites and fresh pasta dishes. This casual dining spot, with its terrace perched high above the property, provides magnificent views of the coastline

claims.text: The full-service spa sits next to the pool in the gardens and overlooks the Mediterranean Sea.

findings.quote: Our full service SPA is located next to the swimming pool in the gardens of Palazzo Avino and overlooks the Mediterranean Sea.

claims.text: Hotel guests get complimentary access to the beach platforms at the Clubhouse by the Sea, based on availability.

findings.quote: There is complimentary access to the beach platforms for all hotel guests (based on availability)

claims.text: The four-seat Chef's Table at Rossellinis has a menu inspired by the old Neapolitan game La Tombola, where each number corresponds to a dish.

findings.quote: Sitting only four diners, the Chef’s Table at Palazzo Avino’s Rossellini’s
a special menu inspired by the ancient Neapolitan game, La Tombola. Similar to bingo, each number corresponds to a dish

claims.text: The Chef's Table ceramics were crafted by local ceramic artist Lucio Liguori from nearby Raito.

findings.quote: The ceramic culinary game and dishes have been specially crafted by local ceramic artist Lucio Liguori from nearby Raito.

claims.text: The Infinito Suite is a duplex in the Tower, with a private terrace and a private infinity pool.

findings.quote: This spacious duplex Suite placed in the highest part of the structure, in the Tower
expansive private terrace with amazing views of the Amalfi Coast, private infinity pool

claims.text: The rooftop solarium has an infinity hydropool with views of the Amalfi Coast.

findings.quote: On the roof top of Palazzo Avino, with a breathtaking view of the Amalfi Coast, we offer a solarium with an infinity hydropool.

claims.text: The Clubhouse by the Sea is in the small town of Marmorata, a 15 minute drive from Ravello, with a complimentary shuttle from the hotel.

findings.quote: is located in the small town of Marmorata, just a 15 minute drive from Ravello.
A complimentary shuttle service to and from the hotel is available

claims.text: The Clubhouse by the Sea is open from May 1st to October.

findings.quote: opens from May 1st to October.

claims.text: There is wheelchair access inside the hotel, but the outside, with its staircases, would be a challenge.

findings.quote: There is wheelchair access inside the hotel but the outside—with its Escher-staircases—would be a challenge.

claims.text: Internal rooms have a high window for natural light but no external view.

findings.quote: high window providing natural light, however no external view.
